shared_types.TaskCreateRequest: struct(title: string, description: OptionalString, status: TaskStatus)
shared_types.TaskUpdateRequest: struct(title: string, description: OptionalString, status: TaskStatus)
shared_types.TaskResponse: struct(id: TaskId, title: TaskTitle, description: OptionalString, status: TaskStatus, created_at: ISOTimestamp, updated_at: ISOTimestamp)

conventions: Type annotations on all public functions (Python backend)
All backend functions must have at least one test
Contract tests may connect to PostgreSQL via DATABASE_URL environment variable
No task is done until its contract tests pass
